hints.title: Binary Tree Mapping
hints.text: Notice that lucky numbers can be viewed as paths in a binary tree where left is 4 and right is 7.

hints.title: Offset Numbering
hints.text: Adding one to k shifts the 1-based indexing directly into a binary representation where the leading 1 represents the tree depth.

hints.title: Direct Translation
hints.text: Convert k + 1 to binary, discard the most significant leading bit, and map 0 to '4' and 1 to '7'.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: k: position of the lucky number
complexity.notes: Direct bit representation mapping of complete binary tree path.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Enumerating lucky numbers sequentially takes O(k) which exceeds limits for large k.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(log k) output string length with minimal working memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the 1-to-1 isomorphism between binary integers and complete binary tree paths.
